H2075.d: patronymically from זְבוּלוּן; a Zebulonite or descendant of Zebulun; Zebulonite.

H2354.d: the same as חוּר or חוּר; Chur, the name of four Israelites and one Midianite; Hur.

H2010.d: from נוּחַ; permission of rest, i.e. quiet; release.

H2033.d: another form for הֲרָרִי; a Harorite or mountaineer; Harorite.

H2013.d: a primitive root; to hush; hold peace (tongue), (keep) silence, be silent, still.

H2412.d: from חָטַף; robber; Chatipha, one of the Nethinim; Hatipha.

H2427.d: and (feminine) חִילָה; from חוּל; a throe (expectant of childbirth); pain, pang, sorrow.

H2088.d: a primitive word; the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that; he, [idiom] hence, [idiom] here, it(-self), [idiom] now, [idiom] of him, the one...the other, [idiom] than the other, ([idiom] out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, [idiom] thus, very, which. Compare זֹאת, זֹה, זוֹ, זוּ.

H2136.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to זָכָה; purity; innocency.

H2245.d: a primitive root (compare חָבָא, חָבָה); properly, to hide (as in the bosom), i.e. to cherish (with affection); love.

H2102.d: or (by permutation) זִיד; a primitive root; to seethe; figuratively, to be insolent; be proud, deal proudly, presume, (come) presumptuously, sod.

H2251.d: a primitive root; to knock out or off; beat (off, out), thresh.

H2108.d: from זוּל; probably scattering, i.e. removal; used adverbially, except; beside, but, only, save.

H2345.d: from an unused root meaning to be warm, i.e. (by implication); sunburnt or swarthy (blackish); brown.

H2406.d: of uncertain derivation; wheat, whether the grain or the plant; wheat(-en).

H2457.d: from חָלָא; properly, disease; hence, rust; scum.

H2188.d: from זוּעַ (in the sense of יֶזַע); perspiration; sweat.

H2091.d: from an unused root meaning to shimmer; gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky; gold(-en), fair weather.

H2230.d: from זָרַם; a gush of water; flood, overflowing, shower, storm, tempest.

H2396.d: or חִזְקִיָּהוּ; also יְחִזְקִיָּה; or יְחִזְקִיָּהוּ; from חָזַק and יָהּ; strengthened of Jah; Chizkijah, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites; Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare יְחִזְקִיָּה.

H2439.d: another form of חוּשׁ; to hurry; make haste.

H2170.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to זָמַר; instrumental music; musick.

H2215.d: a primitive root; to flow away; wax warm.

H2485.d: from חָלַל; a flute (as perforated); pipe.

H2291.d: from חָגַג; festive; Chaggi, an Israelite; also (patronymically) a Chaggite, or descendant of the same; Haggi, Haggites.

H2364.d: from חוּשׁ; haste; Chushah, an Israelite; Hushah.

H2150.d: by reduplication from זָלַל; tremulous, i.e. a twig; sprig.

H2451.d: from חָכַם; wisdom (in a good sense); skilful, wisdom, wisely, wit.

H2071.d: from זָבַד; given, Zabud, an Israelite; Zabud.

H2332.d: causatively from חָוָה; life-giver; Chavvah (or Eve), the first woman; Eve.

H2386.d: from an unused root probably meaning to enclose; a hog (perhaps as penned); boar, swine.

H2194.d: a primitive root; properly, to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged; abhor, abominable, (be) angry, defy, (have) indignation.
r: against which thou hast had indignation

H2390.d: from חָזַק; powerful; [idiom] wax louder, stronger.

H2481.d: from חָלָה; a trinket (as polished); jewel, ornament.

H2492.d: a primitive root; properly, to bind firmly, i.e. (by implication) to be (causatively to make) plump; also (through the figurative sense of dumbness) to dream; (cause to) dream(-er), be in good liking, recover.

H2189.d: by transposition for זְוָעָה; agitation, maltreatment; [idiom] removed, trouble.

H2359.d: probably from חוּר; linen-worker; Churi, an Israelite; Huri.

H2045.d: from שָׁמַע; announcement; to cause to hear.

H2395.d: from חָזַק; strong; Chizki, an Israelite; Hezeki.

H2269.d: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to חָבַר; an associate; companion, fellow.

H2252.d: or חֲבָיָהlemma חֲבָיה missing vowel, corrected to חֲבָיָה; from חָבָה and יָהּ; Jah has hidden; Chabajah, an Israelite; Habaiah.

H2494.d: from חָלַם; a dream; Chelem, an Israelite; Helem. Compare חֶלְדַּי.

H2486.d: or חָלִלָה; a directive from חָלַל; literal fora profaned thing; used (interj.) far be it!; be far, ([idiom] God) forbid.

H2419.d: from חַי and אֵל; living of God; Chiel, an Israelite; Hiel.

H2437.d: from חָוַר in the sense of splendor; Chirah, an Adullamite; Hirah.

H2440.d: from חִישׁ; properly, a hurry; hence (adverb) quickly; soon.

H2144.d: the same as זֵכֶר; Zeker, an Israelite; Zeker.

H2084.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of זְבִינָא; to acquire by purchase; gain.

H2009.d: prolongation for הֵן; lo!; behold, lo, see.

H2237.d: a primitive root (compare זוּר); perhaps to diffuse, i.e. (specifically) to sneeze; sneeze.

H2069.d: or זְבַדְיָהוּ; from זָבַד and יָהּ; Jah has given; Zebadjah, the name of nine Israelites; Zebadiah.

H2231.d: feminine of זֶרֶם; a gushing of fluid (semen); issue.

H2127.d: from זוּעַ; agitation; Zia, an Israelite; Zia.

H2161.d: a primitive root; to plan, usually in a bad sense; consider, devise, imagine, plot, purpose, think (evil).
r: thyself or if thou hast thought evil

H2407.d: from an unused root of uncertain signification; Chattush, the name of four or five Israelites; Hattush.

H2468.d: feminine of חֹלֶד; Chuldah, an Israelitess; Huldah.

H2082.d: a primitive root; apparently properly, to inclose, i.e.; to reside; dwell with.

H2110.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to זוּן; {perhaps properly, to be plump, i.e. (transitively) to nourish}; feed.

H2213.d: from זָרַר (in the sense of scattering); a chaplet (as spread around the top), i.e. (specifically) a border moulding; crown.

H2233.d: from זָרַע; seed; figuratively, fruit, plant, sowing-time, posterity; [idiom] carnally, child, fruitful, seed(-time), sowing-time.
r: between me and thee and thy seed
between me and you and thy seed
thee for unto thee and unto thy seed

H2094.d: a primitive root; to gleam; figuratively, to enlighten (by caution); admonish, shine, teach, (give) warn(-ing).
r: because thou hast not given him warning

H2453.d: from חָכַם; skilful; Chakmoni, an Israelite; Hachmoni, Hachmonite.

H2175.d: from זָמַר; musical; Zimran, a son of Abraham by Keturah; Zimran.

H2024.d: perhaps from הַר; mountainousness; Hara, a region of Media; Hara.

H2442.d: a primitive root (apparently akin to חָקָה through the idea of piercing); properly, to adhere to; hence, to await; long, tarry, wait.

H2057.d: perhaps for עֲנָיָה; Vanjah, an Israelite; Vaniah.

H2344.d: from חוּל; sand (as round or whirling particles); sand.
r: also had been as the sand

H2464.d: from חֶלֶב; galbanam, an odorous gum (as if fatty); galbanum.

H2131.d: (Isaiah 50: (feminine); and זִק; or זֵק; from זָנַק; properly, what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire, or a burning arrow; also (from the original sense of the root) a bond; chain, fetter, firebrand, spark.

H2456.d: a primitive root (compare חָלָה); to be sick; be diseased.

H2003.d: from an unused root apparently meaning to crackle; a dry twig or brushwood; melting.

H2068.d: from זֶבֶד and אֵל; gift of God; zabdiel, the name of two Israelites; Zabdiel.

H2381.d: from חָזָה and אֵל; seen of God; Chaziel, a Levite; Haziel.

H2428.d: from חוּל; probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength; able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).

H2221.d: from זָרַע; something sown, i.e. a plant; sowing, thing that is sown.
r: causeth the things that are sown

H2434.d: another form for חוּץ; a wall; wall.

H2441.d: probably from חָנַךְ in the sense of tasting; properly, the palate or inside of the mouth; hence, the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing); (roof of the) mouth, taste.

H2001.d: of foreign derivation; Haman, a Persian vizier; Haman.

H2482.d: the same as חֲלִי; Chali, a place in Palestine; Hali.

H2325.d: also חָיַב; a primitive root; properly, perhaps to tie, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) to owe, or (by implication) to forfeit; make endanger.

H2376.d: (Aramaic) from חֲזָא; a sight; look, vision.

H2228.d: from זֶרַח and יָהּ; Jah has risen; Zerachjah, the name of two Israelites; Zerahiah.

H2455.d: from חָלַל; properly, exposed; hence, profane; common, profane (place), unholy.

H2200.d: (Aramaic) corresponding to זָעַק; to make an outcry; cry.

H2053.d: probably; a hook (the name of the sixth Hebrew letter); hook.

H2384.d: from חָזָה; a revelation, expectation by dream; vision.

H2257.d: (Aramaic) from חֲבַל; harm (personal or pecuniary); damage, hurt.

H2042.d: from an unused root meaning to loom up; a mountain; hill, mount(-ain).

H2316.d: another form for חֶדֶר; chamber; Chadar, an Ishmaelite; Hadar.

H2061.d: from an unused root meaning to be yellow; a wolf; wolf.

H2081.d: from an unused root (meaning to purchase); gainfulness; Zebina, an Israelite; Zebina.

H2183.d: from זָנָה; adultery; figuratively, idolatry; whoredom.

H2066.d: from זָבַד; giver; Zabad, the name of seven Israelites; Zabad.

H2401.d: feminine of חֵטְא; an offence, or a sacrifice forit; sin (offering).

H2312.d: from an unused root meaning to sting; a prickly plant; brier, thorn.

H2489.d: or חֵלְכָה; apparently from an unused root probably meaning to be dark or (figuratively) unhappy; a wretch, i.e. unfortunate; poor.

H2302.d: a primitive root; to rejoice; make glad, be joined, rejoice.
